findings.evidenceJa: 二メートル近い長物
findings.governingReading: a weapon nearly two meters long
findings.explanation: The extraordinary reach that creates Assassin’s advantage is omitted.

findings.highlight: There is one meter between Saber and Assassin.
findings.evidenceJa: 間合いの差は一メートル
findings.governingReading: the difference between their effective ranges is one meter
findings.explanation: A one-meter disparity in attack range becomes the fighters’ ordinary separation.

findings.evidenceJa: アサシンに踏み込み、敵を両断する
findings.governingReading: step into Assassin’s range and bisect him
findings.explanation: The counterattack’s movement and decisive bisection disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: どちらかが死んでいるかもしれない
findings.governingReading: one of them may already be dead
findings.explanation: The specific fear that either Shirou or Rin may die is generalized into both dying.

findings.highlight: The swords try to push each other away.
findings.evidenceJa: 鍔迫り合いながら、互いを押しのけようとする。
findings.governingReading: locked at the guards, sword and blade strain to force one another aside
findings.explanation: The concrete guard-to-guard bind is omitted.

findings.highlight: if he used his power to strike back at the oncoming attack
findings.evidenceJa: 正面から力のみで打ち合えば
findings.governingReading: if they clashed head-on using force alone
findings.explanation: A direct contest of force becomes Assassin counterattacking Saber’s incoming blow.

findings.evidenceJa: その迷いが、油断となった。
findings.governingReading: that hesitation became carelessness
findings.explanation: Saber’s tempted hesitation, rather than the grammatical question itself, creates the lapse.

findings.highlight: Saber has been forced to fight sideways.
findings.evidenceJa: 体を横にずらされ、真っ平らな足場に立たされている
findings.governingReading: her body has been shifted sideways and set upon perfectly level footing
findings.explanation: The maneuver establishing Tsubame Gaeshi’s required flat geometry becomes a vague sideways orientation.

findings.highlight: allowing no chance for defense or evasion
findings.evidenceJa: 確実に敵を絶命させる
findings.governingReading: certainly kills its target
findings.explanation: The technique’s guaranteed lethal result is omitted after its inescapability.

findings.highlight: A chill runs up her back.
findings.evidenceJa: 首筋に走る悪寒
findings.governingReading: a chill runs along the nape of her neck
findings.explanation: The bodily locus anticipating decapitation is moved away from Saber’s neck.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの力が弱まる。
findings.governingReading: the force Saber exerts weakens
findings.explanation: A graded loss of pressure under threat becomes a complete stop.

findings.highlight: This is no time for you to be staying here.
findings.evidenceJa: 門前払いを受けている場合ではない
findings.governingReading: this is no time to be turned away at the gate
findings.explanation: Assassin’s pointed gatekeeper wordplay disappears.

findings.highlight: She puts power into her arms.
findings.evidenceJa: 剣に力が入る。
findings.governingReading: force enters her sword
findings.explanation: The focus shifts from Saber’s weapon pressure to her arms.

findings.highlight: She puts magical energy into her sword without a plan.
findings.evidenceJa: 為す術もなく剣を合わせる
findings.governingReading: she remains helplessly locked blade to blade
findings.explanation: Physical stalemate and helplessness become poor planning.

findings.highlight: his only compensation for being summoned in this world
findings.evidenceJa: この門を守り続けた報酬
findings.governingReading: his reward for being summoned into this age and continuing to guard this gate
findings.explanation: The service that earns Assassin’s one desired reward disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: その姿が語っていた
findings.governingReading: her entire bearing declares
findings.explanation: Saber’s whole stance embodies total commitment, not only her gaze.

findings.evidenceJa: 腐肉の海
findings.governingReading: sea of rotten flesh
findings.explanation: Putrefaction is softened into unspecified contamination.

findings.evidenceJa: 肌にまとわりつく腐肉
findings.governingReading: the rotten flesh clinging to her skin
findings.explanation: The physically clinging flesh becomes an abstract taint.

findings.highlight: Her mind is too overcome with heat
findings.evidenceJa: 既に四十度を超える頭
findings.governingReading: her head already burning above forty degrees
findings.explanation: The explicit medically dangerous temperature disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: あと二つしかない虎の子の宝石
findings.governingReading: the last two precious reserve jewels she has
findings.explanation: The scarcity and strategic cost of Rin consuming her final two stored jewels disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分の、自分に対する強さ
findings.governingReading: one’s strength in governing oneself
findings.explanation: Rin’s hard self-command is softened into positive self-belief.

findings.highlight: something that should not exist in this world
findings.evidenceJa: 受肉した、この世にあってはならぬモノ
findings.governingReading: an incarnated thing that should not exist in this world
findings.explanation: The discovery that the mass has undergone the same incarnation as a Servant loses its key technical term.

findings.evidenceJa: くあの、ヤロウ、こんなんで、どうやって
findings.governingReading: Damn that bastard—like this, how am I supposed to—
findings.explanation: Shirou’s broken question about how he can possibly win is replaced with a different question about why Archer spoke.

findings.evidenceJa: 食道はポンプのように
findings.governingReading: my esophagus works like a pump
findings.explanation: The precise organ forcing pooled stomach blood outward is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂からの供給は半端じゃない
findings.governingReading: the supply from Tohsaka is tremendous
findings.explanation: Rin’s extraordinary mana support becomes mere sufficiency.

findings.evidenceJa: この体は破裂する
findings.governingReading: this body will burst
findings.explanation: The specific catastrophic bodily rupture caused by mass projection becomes generic death.

findings.evidenceJa: 工程完了。全投影、待機
findings.governingReading: process complete; all projections on standby
findings.explanation: A completed preparation and standby state becomes unrelated rollout and ammunition language.

findings.highlight: if the circuit cannot be controlled
findings.evidenceJa: 回路が焼き切れ制御できなくなれば
findings.governingReading: if the circuits burn out and can no longer be controlled
findings.explanation: The physical cause of control loss is omitted.

findings.highlight: Emiya Shirou will be pierced from within
findings.evidenceJa: 針千本と化す
findings.governingReading: Emiya Shirou will become a thousand-needle pincushion from blades thrusting outward
findings.explanation: The grotesque culmination of Shirou’s body becoming a mass of outward blades is weakened.

findings.highlight: What sort of hero would I be
findings.evidenceJa: 何が英霊か
findings.governingReading: what kind of Heroic Spirit would I be
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s formal class of being becomes generic heroism.

findings.evidenceJa: 千の財宝
findings.governingReading: a thousand treasures
findings.explanation: The explicit thousand is inflated into an unspecified multiple of thousands.

findings.highlight: Freeze out, sword bullet full open…!
findings.evidenceJa: 停止解凍、全投影連続層写
findings.governingReading: release suspension; continuous layered manifestation of all projections
findings.explanation: The emergency command to release and layer every prepared projection becomes incoherent weapon jargon.

findings.evidenceJa: 衝撃が内と外を震わせる
findings.governingReading: the impact shakes both his interior and the outside world
findings.explanation: The simultaneous shock through Shirou’s body and the external battlefield becomes generic environmental shaking.

findings.evidenceJa: 八つ裂きだぞ
findings.governingReading: you will be torn into eight pieces
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s vivid dismemberment threat becomes generic death.

findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯だけでも取り外す
findings.governingReading: detach at least the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: The plan to remove or separate the vessel is changed into recovering possession of it.

findings.highlight: The magical energy I emit and the heat from the crashing Noble Phantasms
findings.evidenceJa: 自ら放出する魔力と、その寸前で衝突し、弾け合う宝具の熱
findings.governingReading: the heat of Noble Phantasms colliding and bursting against his emitted mana immediately before his fingertips
findings.explanation: The defensive collision between emitted mana and incoming weapons is blurred.

findings.evidenceJa: 石柱ともとれるソレ
findings.governingReading: a bizarre sword that might be mistaken for a stone pillar
findings.explanation: The weapon’s defining stone-pillar appearance disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 全速でヤツの剣を解読する
findings.governingReading: analyze his sword at full speed
findings.explanation: The desperate maximum-speed reallocation of Shirou’s processing disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 風が、断層を作り上げる。
findings.governingReading: the wind creates a fault or shearing discontinuity
findings.explanation: The spatially cutting fault formed by the wind becomes abstract chaos.

findings.highlight: I just release the remaining magical energy within me
findings.evidenceJa: 残った魔力を叩きつけた
findings.governingReading: he slams all remaining mana against the attack
findings.explanation: A desperate forceful collision becomes neutral emission.
